symptom: Adding a mandatory terminalReturnKind evidence requirement to the unapproved v0.2 candidate initially caused 55 synthetic tests to fail in two PR CI runs because five other test fixtures still declared the old four-field evidence shape. The failure was test contract drift, not a research payload failure or runner/platform incident.
lesson: A deny-only candidate contract can be correctly strengthened while breaking dozens of downstream synthetic parity and outcome-link tests if their duplicated complete-candidate fixtures are not updated. CI failures at the Test step must be traced to contract fixture drift before assuming research or runner failure.
guardrail: When adding an exact required field to a research-only v0.2 candidate, inventory all complete-candidate fixtures across strict ingress, reference reconciliation, outcome linkage and race parity before running CI. Update every synthetic fixture without changing Outcome Ledger 0.1, production behavior or scoring authority. Add omission/inference negative tests; verify exact-HEAD full CI and post-job cleanup. Never treat a declared terminal return kind as independently attested.
